_about: How the launcher places apps in your Atlas categories. Category ids are the numbers of your categories in atlas.config.json ("05" means "05 Personal"). In order: your own move on the map, names (exact package names, or a prefix ending in *), the category the app declares, essentials (apps that came with the phone), keywords (words in the app's name or package), then Unsorted.
